title: WoW Forever Paladin Build – Holy Healing 31/20/0
dek: Inspect a historical 51-point WoW Forever Holy Paladin healing reference, then start a new calculator route for the live Level 30 Beta cap.
footerHeading: Start a new Level 30 Holy build.

sections.heading: WoW Forever Holy Paladin Build Overview
paragraphs: This historical WoW Forever Holy Paladin example spends 31 points in Holy and 20 points in Protection, with no points in Retribution. It uses talent data from Beta client build 1.60.1.69913. The allocation reaches Holy Shock and Light’s Vigil in the Holy tree, then uses the remaining points on early Protection talents. The 51-point reference exceeds the live Level 30 Beta budget; it is for exploring the tree, not a current healing recommendation.

The 31/20/0 summary and individual ranks below document the historical 51-point setup. Because it exceeds the live Beta cap, the primary calculator action starts a blank tree instead of loading the old allocation. A new legal experiment can be copied as a shareable BuildForge link. No account is required.

sections.heading: What the 31 Holy Points Include
paragraphs: The Holy side starts with Divine Strength and Divine Intellect before moving through healing and spell-support talents. Healing Light, Spiritual Focus, Reverence, and Purifying Power form the middle of the allocation. Four points go into Illumination, while Holy Shock and Light’s Vigil each receive their single available rank. The build also includes Improved Seals and Unyielding Faith as part of the route through the imported 69913 Beta tree.

Light’s Vigil is the final selected Holy talent in this setup and is one of the distinctive talents shown in WoW Forever material. Its displayed effect comes from Beta client build 1.60.1.69913 and may change in a later build. BuildForge labels the client build so players can distinguish versioned imported data from build recommendations. The calculator tooltip for each node includes its source status.

sections.heading: Why the Build Uses 20 Protection Points
paragraphs: After reaching 31 points in Holy, this example places 20 points into the early Protection tree. Toughness and Redoubt receive five ranks each, followed by three points in Precision, two in Guardian’s Favor, and five in Anticipation. This creates a clear Holy-first hybrid for players who want to inspect healing talents alongside defensive utility in one complete allocation.

The 20 Protection points are an example path rather than a performance ranking. WoW Forever talent values, encounters, gear, and class tuning are still developing, so the value of a particular hybrid cannot be established from tree screenshots alone. Treat the setup as a reproducible example for discussion and experimentation. If a later client build changes a prerequisite or rank limit, the planner data and this public build can be updated together.

sections.heading: Holy Healing for Raids and Group Content
paragraphs: This 31/20/0 Holy build is organized around raid healing and group support. The deep Holy path reaches Holy Shock and Light's Vigil, which are useful tools for steady group healing, while Illumination and Purifying Power support efficient mana use. The 20 Protection points add a small defensive base that helps a healer survive focused attention in dungeons and raids.

Group composition, encounter design, and current talent tuning will determine which Holy and Protection points to spend in a live Level 30 route. Start a blank calculator tree, compare legal early choices, and share the new setup with a group before a session. The historical ranks shown here come from Beta client build 1.60.1.69913 and are not a current recommendation.

sections.heading: Edit and Share This WoW Forever Paladin Build
paragraphs: The selected talents on this page preserve the old Holy and Protection ranks for inspection. Open Calculator starts a blank route for a current-cap experiment. Its summary lists your newly chosen ranks, and removing a prerequisite also clears dependent selections under the imported planner rules. The 51-point historical total is not the live Beta budget.

When a current allocation is ready, Copy Build Link creates a compact URL containing its selected talent identifiers and ranks. Anyone opening that link sees the same experiment and can continue editing it. Keep that share link distinct from this older 31/20/0 reference while the talent system is still being documented.
